title.zh: Kraken Parent Payward to Acquire EU-Regulated Lithuanian Bank Saldo
title.en: Kraken Parent Payward to Acquire EU-Regulated Lithuanian Bank Saldo

current_state.zh: Kraken parent Payward announced plans to acquire EU-regulated Lithuanian bank Saldo to expand into traditional banking services like lending and card issuance, with the deal expected to close in 2027 pending regulatory approval.
current_state.en: Kraken parent Payward announced plans to acquire EU-regulated Lithuanian bank Saldo to expand into traditional banking services like lending and card issuance, with the deal expected to close in 2027 pending regulatory approval.
